scripts.text:
[Vestri]
I'm the most skillful blacksmith!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
我是技术最精湛的铁匠！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am the best Armsmith ever!
I don't refine normal, boring items.
I only refine items that are Level 10 or higher.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是有史以来最伟大的武器大师！
我不精炼那些普通、乏味的物品。
我只精炼等级10或以上的物品。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Anyway, you may use my services if your item is Level 10 or higher.
What do you want me to refine?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
总之，如果你的物品等级在10或以上，就可以使用我的服务。
你想让我精炼什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't think I can refine any items you have...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我觉得你身上没有我可以精炼的物品...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You're not wearing
anything there that
I can refine.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你身上没有
我可以精炼的
东西。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't think I can
refine this item at all...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我觉得我完全
无法精炼
这个物品...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I said I don't work with items that are lower than Level 10.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我说过，我不处理等级低于10的物品。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can't refine this
any more. This is as
refined as it gets!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这个已经无法
再精炼了。这已经
是最高精炼度了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm {1} {2}, is that ok?
If you want to refine this {3},
I will need 1 ^003366{4}^000000 and {5} zeny.
Are you sure you want to continue?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，{1} {2}，这样可以吗？
如果你想精炼这件{3}，
我需要1个^003366{4}^000000和{5} Zeny。
你确定要继续吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hm... if you mind... never mind...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...如果你介意的话...算了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This {1} already has been refined several times.
It could be destroyed if I try again.
It won't break for sure, but there is has a small chance.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这件{1}已经被精炼过很多次了。
如果我再次尝试，它可能会损坏。
它不一定会坏，但还是有小概率会失败。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You could be ^FF0000lowering the upgrade level^000000 of the {1},
or if it breaks, you will lose ^FF0000any cards^000000 or special properties added to it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你可能会^FF0000降低{1}的强化等级^000000，
或者如果它损坏，你将失去^FF0000任何卡片^000000或附加的特殊属性。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you still want me to refine it?
I think I have given you enough warning.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你还要我继续精炼吗？
我想我已经给了你足够的警告。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, no challenge is one way to go...
No risk... that could be wise.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，不挑战也是一种选择...
没有风险...那可能是明智的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hm. You don't seem to have enough money or {1}.
Please come back when you have them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯。你似乎没有足够的钱或{1}。
请等你准备好后再来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait a second...
Do you think I'm stupid?!
You switched the item while I wasn't looking! Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等一下...
你觉得我傻吗？！
趁我不注意你换了物品！给我滚出去！

scripts.text: Clang! Clang! Clang! Clang!
scripts.translation: 叮！叮！叮！叮！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Good! Succes!!!
I am the best Armsmith.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好！成功！！！
我是最伟大的武器大师。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Clang! Clang! Clang! Clang!

[{0}]
Oh my god!
The upgrade level has dropped...
I could have made a mistake even though I am the best Armsmith ever.
It just wasn't meant to be.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天哪！
强化等级下降了...
即使我是有史以来最伟大的武器大师，我也可能犯错了。
只是命运使然。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Clang! Clang! Clang!

[{0}]
Hmmm!

[{0}]
Oh my! I've failed to refine stuff...
I didn't mean it!
I could have made a mistake even though I am the best Armsmith ever.
It just wasn't meant to be.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天哪！我精炼失败了...
我不是故意的！
即使我是有史以来最伟大的武器大师，我也可能犯错了。
只是命运使然。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will do a better job next time! Don't worry!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
下次我会做得更好！别担心！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can refine this to the safe limit or a desired number of times. It's your choice.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我可以精炼到安全上限或指定的次数。由你选择。

scripts.text: To the safe limit, please.
scripts.translation: 请精炼到安全上限

scripts.text: I'll decide how many times.
scripts.translation: 我来决定次数

scripts.text: I've changed my mind...
scripts.translation: 我改变主意了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How many times would you like me to refine your item?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你想让我精炼你的物品多少次？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can't refine this item that many times.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我无法精炼这个物品那么多次。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This will try to refine the equipment {1} times past the safe limit. Your equipment may be destroyed... is that ok?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这将尝试在安全上限之外再精炼{1}次。你的装备可能会被破坏...这样可以吗？

scripts.text: Yes...
scripts.translation: 是的...

scripts.text: No...
scripts.translation: 没有...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You said so... So be it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你说是...那就这样吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You said so... So be it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你说是...那就这样吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That will cost you {1} {2} and {3} Zeny. Is that ok?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这将花费你 {1} {2} 和 {3} Zeny。这样可以吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No...
scripts.translation: 没有...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You said so... So be it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你说是...那就这样吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hm. You don't seem to have enough money or {1}.
Please come back when you have them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯。你似乎没有足够的钱或{1}。
请等你准备好后再来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Look here... you don't have any items on...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
喂...你身上没有材料...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Clang... No, but did you imagine I could be so stupid?!
You changed it...
Get out before I stun you with my Hammer!!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哐当...不，难道你以为我会那么蠢吗？！
你换了材料...
在我用锤子把你敲晕之前，给我滚出去！！

scripts.text: Clang! Clang! Clang! Clang!
scripts.translation: 叮！叮！叮！叮！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Clang! Clang! Clang! Clang!

[{0}]
Oh my god!
The upgrade level has dropped...
I could have made a mistake even though I am the best Armsmith ever.
It just wasn't meant to be.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天哪！
强化等级下降了...
即使我是有史以来最伟大的武器大师，我也可能犯错了。
只是命运使然。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Clang! Clang! Clang!

[{0}]
Hmmm!

[{0}]
Oh my! I've failed to refine stuff...
I didn't mean it!
I could have made a mistake even though I am the best Armsmith ever.
It just wasn't meant to be.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天哪！我精炼失败了...
我不是故意的！
即使我是有史以来最伟大的武器大师，我也可能犯错了。
只是命运使然。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will do a better job next time! Don't worry!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
下次我会做得更好！别担心！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Good! Succes!!!
I am the best Blacksmith.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好！成功！！！
我是最伟大的铁匠。

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you lose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 等等！！ -
- 您现在携带的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 请在减轻负重后 -
- 再试一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Austri]
If you bring me 3
Oridecon or Elunium
I can exchange them for
Bradium or Carnium.
Just give me 50,000z.
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
如果你给我3个
神之金属或铝，
我可以把它们换成
魔力之石或混沌金属。
只要给我50,000 Zeny就行。

scripts.text: Oridecon to Bradium.
scripts.translation: 神之金属换魔力之石

scripts.text: Elunium to Carnium.
scripts.translation: 铝换混沌金属

scripts.text: Purified Bradium to Carnium.
scripts.translation: 精炼魔力之石换混沌金属

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Refining with Refined Bradium
can be a little expensive.
I can exchange it for some Carnium.
Take it and use it well.
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
用精炼魔力之石精炼
可能会稍微贵一点。
我可以把它换成一些混沌金属。
拿去好好用吧。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Ok! Here's your {0}.
Take it and use it well.
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
好的！这是你的{0}。
拿去好好用吧。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
You better not be trying
to cheat me because you
don't have enough money
or {0}.
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
你最好别想骗我，
因为你没有足够的Zeny
或{0}。

scripts.text:
[Clink]
My cool dad Holink said I have the world's greatest refine hammer!!
Meow Meow~
Who do you think I am?
Yes!!! You!! You want to refine?
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
我帅气的爸爸霍林克说我有世界上最棒的精炼锤！！
喵喵~
你以为我是谁？
是的！！！就是你！你想精炼？

scripts.text: [Clink]
scripts.translation: [克林克]

scripts.text:
[Clink]
Dad said. There's no cure for stupidity...
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
爸爸说。愚蠢是没有药可治的...

scripts.text:
[Clink]
There's nothing to see here!!
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
这里没什么好看的！！

scripts.text:
[Clink]
What an arrogant left hand this is!
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
这只左手真傲慢！

scripts.text:
[Clink]
What an arrogant right hand this is!
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
这只右手真傲慢！

scripts.text:
[Clink]
Get that dirty thing off my face!!
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
把这个脏东西从我脸上弄走！！

scripts.text:
[Clink]
Kyaong~! Do not provoke me.
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
喵呜~！不要挑衅我。

scripts.text:
[Clink]
Where is the accessory?
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
饰品在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Clink]
Are you talking about the other head part?
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
你在说另一个头部部件吗？

scripts.text:
[Clink]
This can't be refined!!
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
这个不能精炼！！

scripts.text:
[Clink]
Perfect refining. Did I do this for you?
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
完美精炼。这是我为你做的吗？

scripts.text: [Clink]
scripts.translation: [克林克]

scripts.text:
[Clink]
Hmm, an armor refine? Someone like you?
You need ^ff9999{0}^000000 and ^ff9999{1}^000000 Zeny. Do you have them?
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
嗯，防具精炼？像你这样的人？
你需要^ff9999{0}^000000和^ff9999{1}^000000 Zeny。你有吗？

scripts.text:
[Clink]
A level 1 weapon?
Urr... Annoying... Okay, let's try...
You need ^ff9999{0}^000000 and ^ff9999{1}^000000 Zeny. Do you have them?

[Clink]
A level 2 weapon?
You need ^ff9999{0}^000000 and ^ff9999{1}^000000 Zeny. Do you have them?

[Clink]
Woot!! A level 3 weapon? Impressive~
You need ^ff9999{0}^000000 and ^ff9999{1}^000000 Zeny. Do you have them?
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
哇哦！！3级武器？真厉害~
你需要^ff9999{0}^000000和^ff9999{1}^000000 Zeny。你有吗？

scripts.text:
[Clink]
Wow!... A level 4 weapon~!!
You need ^ff9999{0}^000000 and ^ff9999{1}^000000 Zeny. Do you have them?
Yes, I do!!
scripts.translation: 是的，我要！！

scripts.text: Forget about it!!
scripts.translation: 算了吧！！

scripts.text:
[Clink]
I knew it!!
I knew you were not worth trying my magical refining hammer for.
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
我就知道！！
我就知道你不配让我用我的魔法精炼锤。

scripts.text:
[Clink]
Wow!!
This {0} has been refined quite a bit, huh?
You do know that this might break, right?
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
哇！！
这把{0}已经精炼得挺高了，是吧？
你知道这可能会坏掉吗？

scripts.text:
[Clink]
If you break the {0}, you can never use it again.
Cards and enchant effects...
the ^ff0000whole thing will disappear^000000.
You still up for this~?
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
如果{0}坏了，你就再也用不了了。
卡片和附魔效果...
^ff0000整件东西都会消失^000000。
你还想继续吗~？

scripts.text: Yes, I am!!
scripts.translation: 是的，我想！

scripts.text: Forget about it!!
scripts.translation: 算了吧！！

scripts.text:
[Clink]
I knew it!!
You can't even take this big step. Don't think about refining...
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
我就知道！！
你连这一步都迈不出去。别想精炼了...

scripts.text:
[Clink]
Hey you!! Didn't I tell you
that you need ^ff9999{0}^000000 and ^ff9999{1}^000000 Zeny??!!

[Clink]
Wait a second...
Do you think I'm stupid?!
You switched the item while I wasn't looking! Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
等一下...
你以为我傻吗？！
趁我不注意你换了物品！滚出去！

scripts.text:
[Clink]
Cry Hammer!! Cry!!!
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
哭吧锤子！！哭吧！！！

scripts.text:
[Clink]
Huh?! I failed?!
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
什么？！我失败了？！

scripts.text:
[Clink]
Arrgg~ It's all~ Broken...? What a pity~
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
啊呜~全~碎了...？真可惜~

scripts.text:
[Clink]
Hey...!! Get me another one.
This is not possible.
How can my hammer fail from refining?
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
嘿...！！再给我拿一个。
这不可能。
我的锤子怎么会精炼失败？

scripts.text:
[Clink]
Cry Hammer!! Cry!!!
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
哭吧锤子！！哭吧！！！

scripts.text:
[Clink]
Ok!! Perfect!!
There's nothing I can't refine
with this special hammer.
You can praise me!!
What a day!!
scripts.translation:
[克林克]
好！！完美！！
用这把特别的锤子，没有我精炼不了的东西。
你可以夸我了！！
真是美好的一天！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
We sell and exchange various ores used in smelting.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我们出售和交换用于冶炼的各种矿石。

scripts.text: View basic smelting ores
scripts.translation: 查看基础冶炼矿石

scripts.text: View advanced smelting ores
scripts.translation: 查看高级冶炼矿石

scripts.text: View Ether smelting ores
scripts.translation: 查看以太冶炼矿石

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Phracon and Emveretarcon are available for use in smelting low-level weapons.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
强化武器金属-级数一和强化武器金属-级数二可用于冶炼低等级武器。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
We are purifying Elunium Stone or Oridecon Stone, or exchanging them with Bradium or Carnium.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我们纯化铝或神之金属，或者将其与魔力之石或混沌金属进行交换。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
We add Etel Dust to existing smelting ores and replace them with Ether-bearing smelting ores.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我们在现有冶炼矿石中加入以太粉尘，将其替换为含以太的冶炼矿石。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you lack the materials used for smelting, come anytime.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果您缺少冶炼所需的材料，请随时过来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you have {1} or {2}?
We will exchange them for refined products for use as smelting goods.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
您有{1}或{2}吗？
我们会将其兑换为可用于冶炼的成品。
